### Test metadata validation

Need ensure invalid root cases yield exact `{"error":"invalid"}` and not capture. We can test via subprocess with a bunch. Also verify duplicate JSON keys, BOM, nonfinite, trailing, booleans, floats, etc. Campaign main parse_json catches.

Let's write tests for:
- empty input
- invalid JSON
- BOM + valid json
- duplicate keys
- NaN/Infinity
- trailing extra
- version bool True
- version4
- missing key, extra key
- seed invalid
- queries empty,5 distinct,duplicate,float
- services >8, duplicate ids, bad kind, extra/missing keys
- leases >? not; bad prefix host bits/zone/whitespace/prefix len, start>=end,end>MAX+1, subnets empty/dup/out of range/wrong /64, low_count0/33, target_count>65536
- captures wrong encoding/chunks type, >1024 chunks? metadata.
- requests unknown refs, at not query, bad target
- offers bad prefix, capacity, cost, group, requests unknown/dup, pairs> maybe not
- quotas duplicate ids, bad parent, cycle, depth>32, capacity bad
- JSON ints float/bool in fields.
Exact output shape.

We can write a script generating variations and assert `{'error':'invalid'}`. Need capture config invalid? We set captures empty mostly. Also check if capture bad plus metadata bad => invalid.

Let's build.

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/test_metadata.py <<'EOF'
import sys,json,subprocess,copy
BASE={
 'version':3,'seed':'demo',
 'leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],
 'services':[{'id':'t','kind':'tcp'}],
 'queries':[10],'captures':[],
 'requests':[],'offers':[],
 'request_quotas':[{'id':'q','parent':None,'capacity':10}],
 'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':10}],
}
def run_raw(raw):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 try:return json.loads(p.stdout)
 except Exception:return ('NONJSON',p.stdout[:200],p.stderr[:200])
def run(job): return run_raw(json.dumps(job).encode())
def expect_invalid(label,raw=None,job=None):
 out=run_raw(raw) if raw is not None else run(job)
 ok=out=={'error':'invalid'}
 print(('OK ' if ok else 'FAIL '),label,out if not ok else '')
 return ok
ok=True
# parse level
ok &= expect_invalid('empty',raw=b'')
ok &= expect_invalid('bad json',raw=b'{')
ok &= expect_invalid('bom',raw=b'\xef\xbb\xbf'+json.dumps(BASE).encode())
ok &= expect_invalid('dup keys',raw=b'{"version":3,"version":3,"seed":"x","leases":[],"services":[],"queries":[1],"captures":[],"requests":[],"offers":[],"request_quotas":[],"offer_quotas":[]}')
ok &= expect_invalid('nan',raw=json.dumps(BASE).replace('"queries": [10]','"queries": [NaN]').encode())
ok &= expect_invalid('infinity',raw=json.dumps(BASE).replace('"queries": [10]','"queries": [Infinity]').encode())
ok &= expect_invalid('trailing',raw=json.dumps(BASE).encode()+b' {}')
ok &= expect_invalid('top array',raw=b'[]')
# field types
def mut(**kw):
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j.update(kw);return j
ok &= expect_invalid('version bool',job=mut(version=True))
ok &= expect_invalid('version float',job=mut(version=3.0))
ok &= expect_invalid('version 4',job=mut(version=4))
ok &= expect_invalid('seed number',job=mut(seed=1))
ok &= expect_invalid('seed bad',job=mut(seed='a b'))
ok &= expect_invalid('missing key',job={k:v for k,v in BASE.items() if k!='offers'})
j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['extra']=1;ok &= expect_invalid('extra root',job=j)
ok &= expect_invalid('queries empty',job=mut(queries=[]))
ok &= expect_invalid('queries 5',job=mut(queries=[1,2,3,4,5]))
ok &= expect_invalid('queries dup',job=mut(queries=[1,1]))
ok &= expect_invalid('queries float',job=mut(queries=[1.0]))
ok &= expect_invalid('queries bool',job=mut(queries=[True]))
ok &= expect_invalid('queries neg',job=mut(queries=[-1]))
ok &= expect_invalid('queries >max',job=mut(queries=[10**12+1]))
# services
ok &= expect_invalid('services 9',job=mut(services=[{'id':f's{i}','kind':'tcp'} for i in range(9)]))
j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['services']=[{'id':'a','kind':'tcp'},{'id':'a','kind':'adb'}];ok &= expect_invalid('service dup',job=j)
ok &= expect_invalid('service kind',job=mut(services=[{'id':'a','kind':'udp'}]))
j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['services']=[{'id':'a','kind':'tcp','x':1}];ok &= expect_invalid('service extra',job=j)
# leases
def lm(patch):
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['leases'][0].update(patch);return j
for label,patch in [
 ('prefix hostbits',{'prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::1/56'}),
 ('prefix /48',{'prefix':'2001:db8:1::/48'}),
 ('prefix zone',{'prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56%x'}),
 ('prefix whitespace',{'prefix':' 2001:db8:1:1200::/56'}),
 ('start=end',{'start':10,'end':10}),
 ('start>end',{'start':11,'end':10}),
 ('end>max+1',{'end':10**12+2}),
 ('subnets empty',{'subnets':[]}),
 ('subnets dup',{'subnets':[0,0]}),
 ('subnet >255',{'subnets':[256]}),
 ('subnet neg',{'subnets':[-1]}),
 ('subnet bool',{'subnets':[True]}),
 ('low_count 0',{'low_count':0}),
 ('low_count 33',{'low_count':33}),
 ('low_count bool',{'low_count':True}),
]: ok &= expect_invalid(label,job=lm(patch))
j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['leases'][0].update({'prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','subnets':[1]});ok &= expect_invalid('64 subnet nonzero',job=j)
j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['leases'][0].update({'prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','subnets':[0],'low_count':32});ok &= expect_invalid('target count over',job=j)
# Actually one lease /64 gives33 targets, not over. make many leases to exceed65536 but max2048 => 2048*33=67584; duplicate lease ids unique needed.
j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['leases']=[{'id':f'l{i}','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','start':0,'end':10,'subnets':[0],'low_count':32} for i in range(2000)]
ok &= expect_invalid('target total over',job=j)
# captures metadata
ok &= expect_invalid('capture encoding',job=mut(captures=[{'encoding':'gzip','chunks':[]}]))
ok &= expect_invalid('capture chunks type',job=mut(captures=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':'abc'}]))
ok &= expect_invalid('capture chunk nonstr',job=mut(captures=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[1]}]))
ok &= expect_invalid('captures 17',job=mut(captures=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[]} for _ in range(17)]))
j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['captures']=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':['']} for _ in range(2)]; # need >1024 chunks
j['captures']=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':['']*600},{'encoding':'csv','chunks':['']*425}]
ok &= expect_invalid('chunks over',job=j)
# requests
def rm(patch):
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);r={'id':'r','at':10,'lease':'h','target':'2001:db8:1:1200::1','service':'t','group':'q'};r.update(patch);j['requests']=[r];return j
for label,patch in [
 ('req at not query',{'at':11}),('req lease',{'lease':'x'}),('req service',{'service':'x'}),('req group',{'group':'x'}),
 ('req target',{'target':'2001:db9::1'}),('req id bad',{'id':'a b'}),('req at float',{'at':10.0}),('req at bool',{'at':True}),
 ('req extra',{'extra':1}),
]: ok &= expect_invalid(label,job=rm(patch))
j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['requests']=[{'id':'r','at':10,'lease':'h','target':'2001:db8:1:1200::1','service':'t','group':'q'}]*2;ok &= expect_invalid('req dup',job=j)
# offers
def om(patch):
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);o={'id':'x','time':10,'service':'t','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':1,'cost':0,'group':'o','requests':[]};o.update(patch);j['offers']=[o];return j
for label,patch in [
 ('offer time',{'time':10**12+1}),('offer service',{'service':'x'}),('offer prefix bad',{'prefix':'2001:db9::/32'}),
 ('offer prefix /31',{'prefix':'2001:db8::/31'}),('offer cap',{'capacity':4097}),('offer cap neg',{'capacity':-1}),('offer cap bool',{'capacity':True}),
 ('offer cost',{'cost':10**9+1}),('offer group',{'group':'x'}),('offer req unknown',{'requests':['zzz']}),
 ('offer req dup',{'requests':['r','r']}),('offer extra',{'extra':1}),
]: ok &= expect_invalid(label,job=om(patch))
j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['requests']=[{'id':'r','at':10,'lease':'h','target':'2001:db8:1:1200::1','service':'t','group':'q'}];j['offers']=[{'id':'x','time':10,'service':'t','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':1,'cost':0,'group':'o','requests':['r']}]*2;ok &= expect_invalid('offer dup',job=j)
# quotas
def qm(which,rows):
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j[which]=rows;return j
ok &= expect_invalid('rq dup',job=qm('request_quotas',[{'id':'q','parent':None,'capacity':1},{'id':'q','parent':None,'capacity':1}]))
ok &= expect_invalid('rq bad parent',job=qm('request_quotas',[{'id':'q','parent':'x','capacity':1}]))
ok &= expect_invalid('rq cycle',job=qm('request_quotas',[{'id':'a','parent':'b','capacity':1},{'id':'b','parent':'a','capacity':1}]))
ok &= expect_invalid('rq self',job=qm('request_quotas',[{'id':'a','parent':'a','capacity':1}]))
ok &= expect_invalid('rq depth33',job=qm('request_quotas',[{'id':f'n{i}','parent':None if i==0 else f'n{i-1}','capacity':1} for i in range(33)]))
ok &= expect_invalid('rq cap',job=qm('request_quotas',[{'id':'q','parent':None,'capacity':4097}]))
ok &= expect_invalid('rq bool',job=qm('request_quotas',[{'id':'q','parent':None,'capacity':True}]))
# valid depth32 accepted -> should not error invalid
j=qm('request_quotas',[{'id':f'n{i}','parent':None if i==0 else f'n{i-1}','capacity':1} for i in range(32)])
out=run(j);print('OK depth32 accepted' if isinstance(out,dict) and 'error' not in out else ('FAIL depth32 '+str(out)))
ok &= isinstance(out,dict) and 'error' not in out
print('ALL',ok)
EOF
cd /workspace && timeout 600 python3 tmp/test_metadata.py
